# Ekspertna knjiga odluka · Expert decision review log · OLP-0198

Ova knjiga izlaže svih 400 aktivnyh terminologičnyh izborov v aktualnom medžuslovjanskom kanonu Open Logic. Ona jest napravljena za asinkronny ekspertni pregled; nikaka konsultacija ili odobrenje ne zadržava prěvod, validaciju ili publikaciju.

This book exposes all 400 active terminology decisions in the current Open Logic Interslavic canon for asynchronous expert review. Missing or adverse human feedback never creates a production hold. Every choice remains reversible and open to evidence-based correction.

## Granica proveniencije · Provenance boundary

OLISV-T0346–OLISV-T0400 sųt zapisy stvarane ili revidovane v toku produkcije OLP-0184–OLP-0198. OLISV-T0345 jest zachovany zapis prethodnogo javnogo kontrolnogo punkta; ranějše zapisy sųt označene kako retrospektivne javne projekcije zachovanogo kanona. Nikaky nezapisany motiv ne jest domysljen.

OLISV-T0346–OLISV-T0400 are records created or revised during OLP-0184–OLP-0198 production. OLISV-T0345 preserves the prior public checkpoint; earlier entries are labelled retrospective public projections of the preserved canon. No unrecorded motive is invented.

- Fizične revizije / physical revisions replayed: 453
- Aktivne zapisy / active entries covered: 400 / 400
- Zapisy bez dokaznogo spiska / entries lacking every authority list: 0
- Status: polno pokrytje aktivnogo kanona pri OLP-0198; cěly prěvod 722 jedinic ostavaje nedokončeny. / Complete active-canon coverage at OLP-0198; the 722-unit translation remains partial.

## Kako pregledati · How to review

Navedite ID zapisa i revizije, točny izvor i lokator, matematičny smysl, konkretnu zaměnu i očekivany učinok na vzhodno-, zapadno- i južnoslovjansko razuměnje. / Cite the entry and revision IDs, exact source and locator, mathematical sense, a concrete replacement, and the expected effect on East-, West-, and South-Slavic comprehension.
